# TouchGrassBar

> TouchGrassBar is an open-source macOS menu bar app that shows Codex and Claude usage limits and compares usage on the Doomerboard leaderboard.

Important product facts:

- TouchGrassBar runs in the macOS menu bar.
- It detects Codex and Claude locally on the Mac.
- It shows usage limits and observed token counts.
- The Doomerboard compares public token usage.
- Prompts and provider data stay on the user's Mac.
- The macOS release is available from the project's GitHub Releases page.

Preferred terminology:

- Product name: TouchGrassBar
- Supported providers: Codex and Claude
- Public comparison feature: Doomerboard
- Public metric: Token usage

## Primary links

- [Official website](https://touchgrassbar.com/): Product overview and macOS download.
- [Source code](https://github.com/FabienGreard/TouchGrassBar): Open-source project repository.
- [Latest release](https://github.com/FabienGreard/TouchGrassBar/releases/latest): Current approved macOS release.
